scenario.generator: R Schaefer biomass trajectory and Poisson sampled catch counts
scenario.scope: Synthetic teaching example; not observations from a real fishery.
notes: Sampled set counts supply an abundance index, not a census of annual removals.
Known annual removals and sampled CPUE share the declared biomass trajectory.
Growth sensitivities and MSE perturbations illustrate assumptions; they are not validated uncertainty.
